title: wrkq Task Contract
intent: Render the wrkq Task DTO contract from validated semantic artifacts derived from current wrkq source, validators, and task migrations.

assumptions: The Task data-contract artifact is the semantic source of truth for structured fields.
Rendered HTML is disposable output generated by archdoc.
exclusions: This assembly does not document comments, task relations, attachments, evidence, workflow runs, or daemon-only response wrappers.
applicability.temporal: source snapshot at wrkq commit 86958ad on 2026-06-06

knownGaps: The current renderer uses a generic semantic-contract chrome; wrkq-specific page framing lives in this assembly intent and artifact metadata.

refs.note: Projects the Task DTO artifact into the final HTML contract.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Task owns a single unit of human-agent work: identity, path placement, lifecycle state, routing, workflow metadata, content, and audit stamps. Structured fields are not copied here; they are projected from the Task data-contract artifact.

sections.title: Task DTO
sections.body: Field names below use domain.Task JSON tags. Optionality follows Go pointers and omitempty tags; enum literals follow current domain validation and task-table constraints.

sections.title: Scope Notes
sections.body: The deprecated sdk_session_id database column is intentionally absent from this JSON contract because domain.Task marks it json:"-". The session_id JSON field is backed by the cp_session_id database column.
